departing_trials.source_excerpt: abstract source-reported HR (registered estimand): Neither EPA-DHA nor ALA reduced this primary end point (hazard ratio with EPA-DHA, 1.01; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.87 to 1.17; P=0.93; hazard ratio with ALA, 0.91; 95% CI, 0.78 to 1.05; P=0.20).

SU.FOL.OM3 (PMID 21115589) full text (PMC2993045, Results / fig 4): 'Allocation to omega 3 fatty acids was not associated with any significant effect on major vascular events (81 v 76 patients, hazard ratio 1.08 (0.79 to 1.47), P=0.64; fig 4).' This is the omega-3 MAIN-EFFECT MARGINAL (omega-3 present vs absent, collapsed over the 2x2 B-vitamin allocation) on the trial's declared primary outcome (major cardiovascular events). Double-blind, placebo-controlled factorial; 2501 patients with a history of myocardial infarction, unstable angina, or ischaemic stroke (secondary prevention). Estimand-matched: major vascular events, HR, intention-to-treat, trial end.

ClinicalTrials.gov results (structured target endpoint): outcome 'Composite of CV Death, Nonfatal MI (Including Silent MI), or Nonfatal Stroke.' HR 0.74 (95% CI 0.65 to 0.83); endpoint counts 459/4089 (AMR101) vs 606/4090 (Placebo)
ClinicalTrials.gov results (structured target endpoint): outcome 'The Composite of CV Events' HR 1.05 (95% CI 0.93 to 1.19); endpoint counts 541/6539 (Epanova) vs 517/6539 (Placebo)

direction_policy: Estimate-absence transitions take precedence: numeric to absent RESULT_REMOVED; absent to numeric RESULT_ADDED; both absent NO_DIRECTION even if candidate k changes. For two numerical results, AWAY_FROM_NULL takes priority if any of larger absolute effect (absolute log ratio or absolute MD), narrower comparable CI, more favourable point, or newly favourable CI applies. Mixed signals are disclosed. A newly favourable CI with no prior CI is a new claim, never a computed narrowing. Otherwise weakening is TOWARD_NULL; unchanged point with membership change is MEMBERSHIP_ONLY. All outcomes here favour lower values except ovulation, which favours higher odds; harm disappearance is flagged for presentation favourability, never treated as evidence of safety.
